about: A self-hosted bookmark archive for saving and organizing links.

prs.title: Newest first and Z to A sorting work on every page
prs.broken: List, tag and guest pages read the sort direction from the wrong setting, so choosing Newest or Title Z-A still sorted the links in ascending order.
prs.changed: Those pages now read the direction from the right setting, as the main links, lists and tags pages already did.
prs.matters: Sorting does what people pick, including for guests browsing a shared collection.

prs.title: Clearing a link title shows an error, not a crash
prs.broken: Clearing the title while editing a link ended in a server error, and the edit was lost.
prs.changed: An empty title now shows a clear message on the form. Requests that leave the title out still work.
prs.matters: People can fix the mistake and keep their changes instead of losing them.
